name: React UI Quality
description: Rules for React interfaces with reusable components, stable stateful interactions, and accessible UI primitives.

rules.instruction: Keep repeated UI patterns in reusable React components with explicit props; do not duplicate large JSX blocks.
Keep loading, error, empty, and success states explicit for data-backed components; never hide async failure behind an empty state.
Prefer transform and opacity transitions for React interaction feedback and keep effects interruptible.
